NMDS plant genus data preparation
```{r plant data NMDS prep, include = FALSE}

plant_nmds_relab <- mappingdata[, which(names(mappingdata) == "achillea"):which(names(mappingdata) == "vicia")]

# Add metadata
plant_nmds_relab$site <- mappingdata$site
plant_nmds_relab$visit <- mappingdata$visit
plant_nmds_relab$plot <- mappingdata$plot

# Replace NA values with 0
plant_nmds_relab[is.na(plant_nmds_relab)] <- 0
```

```{r NMDS plant relative abundance per site and visit, include = FALSE}

# Define species columns
species_cols <- names(plant_nmds_relab)[which(names(plant_nmds_relab) == "achillea"):which(names(plant_nmds_relab) == "vicia")]

# Replace NA with 0
plant_nmds_relab[is.na(plant_nmds_relab)] <- 0

# Get unique regions and visits
regions <- unique(mappingdata$region)
visits <- sort(unique(plant_nmds_relab$visit))

# Initialize plot list
nmds_plots <- list()

# Loop over regions and visits
for (r in regions) {
  for (v in visits) {
    subset_data <- mappingdata %>%
      filter(region == r, visit == v)

    species_data <- subset_data[, species_cols]
    meta_data <- subset_data[, c("site", "plot")]

    # Remove empty rows
    valid_rows <- rowSums(species_data) > 0
    species_data <- species_data[valid_rows, ]
    meta_data <- meta_data[valid_rows, ]

    if (nrow(species_data) < 3) next

    species_data <- apply(species_data, 2, as.numeric)
    set.seed(123)
    nmds <- metaMDS(species_data, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)

    scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
    scores_df$site <- meta_data$site
    scores_df$plot <- meta_data$plot
    scores_df$region <- r
    scores_df$visit <- v

    p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = site)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("NMDS -", r, "- Visit", v),
        subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds$stress, 3)),
        x = "NMDS1",
        y = "NMDS2"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

    nmds_plots[[paste0(r, "_Visit_", v)]] <- p
  }
}

# Combine and display plots (adjust layout as needed)
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(nmds_plots, ncol = 2)
print(combined_plot)


```


``` {r plant data NMDS plot, include = FALSE}
species_cols <- names(plant_nmds_relab)[which(names(plant_nmds_relab) == "achillea"):which(names(plant_nmds_relab) == "vicia")]

nmds_plots <- list()
adonis_results <- list()
dispersion_tests <- list()

for (v in 1:4) {
  visit_data <- plant_nmds_relab[plant_nmds_relab$visit == v, ]
  species_data <- visit_data[, species_cols]
  meta_data <- visit_data[, c("site", "plot")]

  valid_rows <- rowSums(species_data) > 0
  species_data <- species_data[valid_rows, ]
  meta_data <- meta_data[valid_rows, ]

  if (nrow(species_data) < 3) next
 
  species_data <- apply(species_data, 2, as.numeric)
  set.seed(123)
  nmds <- metaMDS(species_data, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)

  scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
  scores_df$site <- meta_data$site
  scores_df$plot <- meta_data$plot
  scores_df$visit <- v

  p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = site)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("NMDS of Plant Community - Visit", v),
      subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds$stress, 3)),
      x = "NMDS1",
      y = "NMDS2"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

  nmds_plots[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- p
  adonis_results[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- adonis2(species_data ~ meta_data$site, method = "bray")
  dispersion_tests[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- permutest(betadisper(vegdist(species_data, method = "bray"), meta_data$site))
}

```


```{r, include = FALSE}
for (v in 1:4) {
  visit_data <- plant_nmds_relab[plant_nmds_relab$visit == v, ]
  species_data <- visit_data[, species_cols]
  meta_data <- visit_data[, c("site", "plot")]
  
  # Calculate valid rows first (rows where species sums > 0)
  valid_rows <- rowSums(species_data) > 0
  
  # Subset species and meta data by valid rows
  species_data <- species_data[valid_rows, ]
  meta_data <- meta_data[valid_rows, ]
  
  # Now assign surveyID only for the valid rows
  survey_ids <- mappingdata$surveyID[plant_nmds_relab$visit == v]
  meta_data$surveyID <- survey_ids[valid_rows]
  
  if (nrow(species_data) < 3) next
  
  species_data <- apply(species_data, 2, as.numeric)
  set.seed(123)
  nmds <- metaMDS(species_data, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)
  
  scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
  scores_df$site <- meta_data$site
  scores_df$plot <- meta_data$plot
  scores_df$visit <- v
  scores_df$surveyID <- meta_data$surveyID
  
  p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = site)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = surveyID), vjust = -0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("NMDS of Plant Community - Visit", v),
      subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds$stress, 3)),
      x = "NMDS1",
      y = "NMDS2"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  
  nmds_plots[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- p
  adonis_results[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- adonis2(species_data ~ meta_data$site, method = "bray")
  dispersion_tests[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- permutest(betadisper(vegdist(species_data, method = "bray"), meta_data$site))
}

```


```{r plot NMDS plant genus, include = FALSE}
# Combine the plots in a 2x2 grid
combined_plot <- (nmds_plots[["Visit_1"]] | nmds_plots[["Visit_2"]]) /
                 (nmds_plots[["Visit_3"]] | nmds_plots[["Visit_4"]])

# Print the combined plot
print(combined_plot)

# Print PERMANOVA (adonis2) and PERMDISP results for all visits
for (v in 1:4) {
  cat("\n---\n")
  cat(paste0("### Visit ", v, "\n\n"))
  
  cat("PERMANOVA (adonis2):\n")
  print(adonis_results[[paste0("Visit_", v)]])
  
  cat("\nPERMDISP (homogeneity of dispersion):\n")
  print(dispersion_tests[[paste0("Visit_", v)]])
}

```

remove outliers
```{r, include = FALSE}
# Initialize list to store cleaned plots and results
nmds_plots_clean <- list()
adonis_results_clean <- list()
dispersion_tests_clean <- list()

for (v in 1:4) {
  visit_data <- plant_nmds_relab[plant_nmds_relab$visit == v, ]
  species_data <- visit_data[, species_cols]
  meta_data <- visit_data[, c("site", "plot")]
  
  valid_rows <- rowSums(species_data) > 0
  species_data <- species_data[valid_rows, ]
  meta_data <- meta_data[valid_rows, ]
  
  survey_ids <- mappingdata$surveyID[plant_nmds_relab$visit == v]
  meta_data$surveyID <- survey_ids[valid_rows]
  
  if (nrow(species_data) < 3) next
  
  species_data <- apply(species_data, 2, as.numeric)
  
  set.seed(123)
  # Run initial NMDS on all valid rows
  nmds_full <- metaMDS(species_data, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)
  
  scores_full <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_full, display = "sites"))
  
  # Calculate centroid and distance from centroid
  centroid <- colMeans(scores_full)
  scores_full$dist_from_centroid <- sqrt((scores_full$NMDS1 - centroid[1])^2 + (scores_full$NMDS2 - centroid[2])^2)
  
  # Define outlier threshold (mean + 2 SD)
  threshold <- mean(scores_full$dist_from_centroid) + 2 * sd(scores_full$dist_from_centroid)
  
  # Filter to remove outliers
  non_outliers <- scores_full$dist_from_centroid <= threshold
  
  species_data_no_out <- species_data[non_outliers, ]
  meta_data_no_out <- meta_data[non_outliers, ]
  
  # Re-run NMDS without outliers
  nmds_clean <- metaMDS(species_data_no_out, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)
  scores_clean <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_clean, display = "sites"))
  
  scores_clean$site <- meta_data_no_out$site
  scores_clean$plot <- meta_data_no_out$plot
  scores_clean$visit <- v
  scores_clean$surveyID <- meta_data_no_out$surveyID
  
  p_clean <- ggplot(scores_clean, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = site)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = surveyID), vjust = -0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("NMDS of Plant Community - Visit", v, "(Outliers removed)"),
      subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds_clean$stress, 3)),
      x = "NMDS1",
      y = "NMDS2"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  
  nmds_plots_clean[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- p_clean
  adonis_results_clean[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- adonis2(species_data_no_out ~ meta_data_no_out$site, method = "bray")
  dispersion_tests_clean[[paste0("Visit_", v)]] <- permutest(betadisper(vegdist(species_data_no_out, method = "bray"), meta_data_no_out$site))
}

# Combine the cleaned plots in a 2x2 grid
combined_plot_clean <- (nmds_plots_clean[["Visit_1"]] | nmds_plots_clean[["Visit_2"]]) /
                       (nmds_plots_clean[["Visit_3"]] | nmds_plots_clean[["Visit_4"]])

# Print the combined cleaned plot
print(combined_plot_clean)

# Print PERMANOVA and PERMDISP results for all visits (cleaned)
for (v in 1:4) {
  cat("\n---\n")
  cat(paste0("### Visit ", v, " (Outliers removed)\n\n"))
  
  cat("PERMANOVA (adonis2):\n")
  print(adonis_results_clean[[paste0("Visit_", v)]])
  
  cat("\nPERMDISP (homogeneity of dispersion):\n")
  print(dispersion_tests_clean[[paste0("Visit_", v)]])
}
```
```{r plant NMDS by region and visit, include = FALSE}
plant_nmds_relab$region <- mappingdata$region
plant_nmds_relab$site <- mappingdata$site
plant_nmds_relab$plot <- mappingdata$plot
plant_nmds_relab$visit <- mappingdata$visit
plant_nmds_relab$surveyID <- mappingdata$surveyID
# Define species columns
species_cols <- names(plant_nmds_relab)[which(names(plant_nmds_relab) == "achillea"):which(names(plant_nmds_relab) == "vicia")]


# Initialize result containers
nmds_plots_region <- list()
adonis_results_region <- list()
dispersion_tests_region <- list()

regions <- c("Aire", "Scheulte", "Thiele", "Schwarzbach")

for (reg in regions) {
  for (v in 1:4) {
    
    visit_data <- plant_nmds_relab[plant_nmds_relab$visit == v & plant_nmds_relab$region == reg, ]
    if (nrow(visit_data) < 3) next
    
    species_data <- visit_data[, species_cols]
    meta_data <- visit_data[, c("region", "site", "plot")]
    
    # Filter valid rows
    valid_rows <- rowSums(species_data) > 0
    species_data <- species_data[valid_rows, ]
    meta_data <- meta_data[valid_rows, ]
    
    # Add surveyID
    survey_ids <- mappingdata$surveyID[mappingdata$visit == v & mappingdata$region == reg]
    meta_data$surveyID <- survey_ids[valid_rows]
    
    if (nrow(species_data) < 3) next
    
    species_data <- apply(species_data, 2, as.numeric)
    
    set.seed(123)
    nmds <- metaMDS(species_data, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)
    
    scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
    scores_df$site <- meta_data$site
    scores_df$plot <- meta_data$plot
    scores_df$visit <- v
    scores_df$region <- reg
    scores_df$surveyID <- meta_data$surveyID
    
    p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = site)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_text(aes(label = surveyID), vjust = -0.8, size = 2) +
      stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        title = paste("NMDS -", reg, "- Visit", v),
        subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds$stress, 3)),
        x = "NMDS1",
        y = "NMDS2"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
    
    plot_key <- paste0("Region_", reg, "_Visit_", v)
    nmds_plots_region[[plot_key]] <- p
    
    adonis_results_region[[plot_key]] <- adonis2(species_data ~ meta_data$site, method = "bray")
    dispersion_tests_region[[plot_key]] <- permutest(betadisper(vegdist(species_data, method = "bray"), meta_data$site))
  }
}

table_rows <- expand.grid(region = c("Aire", "Scheulte", "Thiele", "Schwarzbach"), visit = 1:4)

for (i in 1:nrow(table_rows)) {
  reg <- table_rows$region[i]
  v <- table_rows$visit[i]
  
  visit_data <- plant_nmds_relab[plant_nmds_relab$region == reg & plant_nmds_relab$visit == v, ]
  species_data <- visit_data[, species_cols]
  valid_rows <- rowSums(species_data) > 0
  
  cat(paste0("Region: ", reg, ", Visit: ", v, " — Valid plots: ", sum(valid_rows), "\n"))
}

# Combine and show plots per region
for (reg in regions) {
  plot_list <- list()
  for (v in 1:4) {
    key <- paste0("Region_", reg, "_Visit_", v)
    plot_list[[v]] <- nmds_plots_region[[key]]
  }
  # Only combine if at least some plots exist
  if (any(!sapply(plot_list, is.null))) {
    combined <- (plot_list[[1]] | plot_list[[2]]) / (plot_list[[3]] | plot_list[[4]])
    print(combined)
  }
}

# Print results per region/visit
for (key in names(adonis_results_region)) {
  cat("\n---\n")
  cat(paste0("### ", key, "\n\n"))
  
  cat("PERMANOVA (adonis2):\n")
  print(adonis_results_region[[key]])
  
  cat("\nPERMDISP (homogeneity of dispersion):\n")
  print(dispersion_tests_region[[key]])
}
```
